primary_experiment.citation: Cong, Chan & Lee (2017), J. Hydraul. Eng. 143(9), 04017039

companion_cfd.citation: Chan, Cong & Lee (2018), J. Hydraul. Eng. 144(3), 04017071
companion_cfd.role: methodological cross-check; its fine-grid B1 uses H0=0.88 m and is not B-H1

coordinate_system.x: horizontal pipe axis, upstream to capped end

boundaries.inlet: pressure-driven constant reservoir head H0=0.66 m
boundaries.atmosphere: hydrostatic p_rgh=101332.42484 Pa, referenced to 101325 Pa absolute at y=0.635 m
boundaries.contact_angle: not prescribed; no fitted value is available

valve.baseline: instantaneously fully open at t=0, matching Chan et al. (2018)
valve.static_hold: zero-thickness impermeable no-slip wall baffle at x=5.99 m
valve.sensitivity_note: equivalent passive-resistance uncertainty model, not a measured ball-angle law

resistance_model.linearization: non-negative 0.5*rho*K*mag(U_old)/L coefficient added to the momentum diagonal
resistance_model.zone_volume_check: equivalent 50 mm-pipe length must agree with resistance_length within 20%
resistance_model.purpose: passive mesh-coupled loss without the unstable old-flux pressure-jump feedback; no pressure or velocity source

refined.purpose: resolve the approximately 0.55 mm Dr=16 mm falling film reported by Chan et al. (2018)

solver.energy_formulation: total sensible enthalpy with pressure-time-derivative work and kinetic-energy transport
solver.energy_formulation_reference: standard OpenFOAM compressible total-enthalpy transformation used by rhoPimpleFoam

turbulence_closure.companion_cfd_difference: Chan et al. (2018) used standard k-epsilon but did not report initial or inlet turbulence quantities
turbulence_closure.interpretation: not a line-by-line reproduction of the companion FLUENT model; retain as a declared non-fitted closure rather than infer missing turbulence inputs from B-H1 outcomes

temperature_acceptance.criterion: all recorded extrema must remain within bounds

conservation_acceptance.phase_mass_fluxes: registered solver waterRhoPhi and airRhoPhi with exact sum rhoPhi
conservation_acceptance.total_mass_flux: direct sum of solver rhoPhi over atmosphere and inlet

postprocessing.legacy_1d_comparison: tracked frozen CSV, consumed without regeneration; qualitative only because its effective pipe and tee geometry differ
postprocessing.pressure_comparison: Fig.10(a) is Run B-1, not the B-H1 high-speed realization; same nominal Dr/H0/L0, morphology-only cross-run comparison using PT1_proxy

velocity_metric.method: height interval divided by interpolated first-passage time after gas first enters the riser

postprocessing.geyser_detection: Yfs reaches 98% of the physical rim height or cumulative positive rim water transfer reaches 1e-9 m3
postprocessing.ejected_water: time integral of positive upward water flux through the physical riser mouth
postprocessing.exterior_water: instantaneous water inventory above the physical rim

experimental_targets_not_used_as_forcing.pressure_csv_run: B-1 (different realization; not pointwise B-H1 validation)
